_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::fluid_turbulence#1 and a FALSIFICATION of its Signal. The entry told the reader to 'compute the resolved/total TKE ratio from diagnostics'. 4C prints no TKE of any kind: neither the log nor the <output>.flow_statistics file contains 'kinetic energy', 'TKE' or 'resolved', with the Smagorinsky LES model off or on -- the LES arm is a real run that reaches 'Checking results of 2 tests' and shifts both of them, so its silence about TKE is not the silence of a deck that failed to start. What the statistics file does contain, only when DUMPING_PERIOD > 0, is the plane-averaged first- and second-order moments (mean u^2, mean v^2, mean w^2, mean u*v, ...) from which a resolved TKE can be assembled by the user; there is no total and therefore no ratio. Measured on the upstream channel deck f3_cha_8x8x8_recongradl2. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf).
expect_in_output: Statistics for turbulent incompressible channel flow (first- and second-order moments)

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: leave DUMPING_PERIOD at the upstream 0, so the statistics file stays empty and there are no second-order moments to point at instead of a TKE ratio. DUMP_STATS_ROWS and DUMP_HAS_SECOND_MOMENTS drop to 0, so the fixture must go red.
